singleTakeaway: Soft AI reassurance is useless when the actual payment problem is still unresolved.
hook: Show the blocked payment problem first, then expose the empty comfort, then prove the product is still stuck.

screens.purpose: Establish the payment failure and the three-day delay immediately.
screens.layoutSnapshot: A left-aligned complaint bubble dominates the chat column, with a muted timestamp and minimal thread chrome around it.
screens.background: Warm neutral support surface with soft depth and restrained UI framing.
screens.primaryMotion: The user complaint card enters and locks attention.

screens.purpose: Show the assistant replying with comfort instead of action.
screens.uiSurface: assistant reply bubble in the same community chat
screens.layoutSnapshot: A single assistant reply bubble sits directly under the complaint and takes over the visual center with one short reassurance line.
screens.background: The same warm neutral chat surface remains still so the reply bubble is the only moving focus.
screens.primaryMotion: The empty comfort reply expands softly into view.

screens.purpose: Escalate frustration with a fake solved message.
screens.uiSurface: quick user pushback plus assistant reply
screens.layoutSnapshot: A compact resolved status chip lands above a short closing reply, visually shutting down the thread.
screens.background: The chat frame stays calm and static so the resolved state reads as the only active event.
screens.primaryMotion: The false resolved state lands with abrupt closure.

screens.purpose: Prove the payment flow is still blocked.
screens.layoutSnapshot: A centered payment panel fills most of the frame with the amount, action area, and a stuck loading state clearly visible.
screens.background: Warm neutral product surface with a quiet gradient and no competing accents, so the blocked payment state dominates.
screens.primaryMotion: Hard cut into the stuck payment panel, then dead-stop hold.

colorRoles: Use neutral off-brand colors for the broken assistant UI.
Reserve stronger contrast for payment failure and blocked states.
Use Lucius purple only as a restrained closing-tag quality cue.
typeRoles: Use sans-serif only in the negative example UI.
Use one strong headline layer with restrained support labels.
Keep any Lucius closing tag secondary.
radiusRules: Use soft, consistent rounded corners across chat and payment surfaces.
Do not mix incompatible corner languages.
backgroundRules: Use a warm neutral background with quiet depth.
Keep the background restrained so the proof element remains dominant.
graphicLanguage: Use clean SaaS UI surfaces and minimal chrome.
Avoid decorative clutter or joke framing.
motionTone: Motion should feel quietly confident and readable.
The final proof state should end in a dead-stop hold.
prohibitedPatterns: No flashy AI magic or glitch spectacle.
No competing animated elements on the same screen.

nonGoals: Do not make the piece comedic or meme-like.
Do not let comfort copy feel like actual support value.
Do not make the broken assistant look like Lucius.
